message: 咲良シンという魔王

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, everyone. What do you think about my convictions?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They're extremely... vague」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, thanks」

name: Misa
message: 「I understand you're shaken by how suddenly things took a turn, but losing sight of your goal isn't a good trend」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Try calming down and thinking it over a bit」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmmgh...」
Man, just sitting around thinking really makes me restless.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Then let's get to preparing for the Holy Night Festival!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, talk about out of nowhere!」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured if I get my body moving, something's bound to come to me eventually」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee... That is much more like you, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, let's give it our all today too!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!!」
And so, until special training began, we threw ourselves into our usual Student Council duties.
In anticipation of the Holy Night Festival, the academy begins taking on a Christmas look.

name: Synn
message: 「Hmmmm~」

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong, Synn-kun」

name: Ria
message: 「...Don't tell me you're thinking of going to see Azel-san, are you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! I couldn't possibly do that behind Melilot-san's back. It's not that...」

name: Synn
message: 「The North Wind and the Sun... no, what was it again...」

name: Synn
message: 「I was just wondering if Azel might get curious and come out if we do something fun right here」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah. You mean the story of Ama-no-Iwato? Where they threw a big festive commotion to coax the sun out...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, yes, that's the one! And the tactic is to sweep her right in the moment she peeks out out of curiosity」

name: Ria
message: 「Wait, Synn-kun. Did you anticipate that and choose this place as the venue?」

name: Synn
message: 「If that were true, I'd be the one falling out of my chair.」
Azel's resolve is probably something far beyond anything I could ever imagine.
I can't possibly expect this to reach her heart, yet this is about the only thing I'm capable of doing.

name: Ria
message: 「Still, I think being able to come up with something like that on the spot is what makes you amazing, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...\s03 I'm literally just saying whatever pops into my head.」

name: Ria
message: 「Even if it's just off the cuff, it comes out of you so naturally.」

name: Ria
message: 「Earlier, when Melilot-san was talking about Azel-san...」

name: Ria
message: 「Seeing how she was acting, no matter how I looked at it, I couldn't see Azel-san as anything other than an enemy.」

name: Ria
message: 「And yet, you just treated her like a friend as if it were the most natural thing in the world.」

name: Ria
message: 「You know, Synn-kun, when you talked to that demon, I was super surprised.」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean when we all ate meat buns together?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. When I let out that squeaky, frantic yelp. It was just completely unthinkable to me back then.」

name: Ria
message: 「But you know, after watching you all this time, I feel like I can understand why you'd do that.」

name: Ria
message: 「Because whether someone is an angel, a demon, or anyone else, you treat everyone without any prejudice.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that... really true?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. I'm sure of it. That's why I think you were chosen to be the Demon Lord, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's hereditary, you know?」

name: Ria
message: 「Even so, it's because there are things only you can do, Synn-kun.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Ginyaaa!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm?」

name: Pasta
message: 「What's going on, nya... I can't do a single thing against them, nya...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, you're...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-what, Crusaders!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「However, I do not have the time to be dealing with you lot today, nyan」

name: Synn
message: 「Why the polite speech?」

name: Ria
message: 「Finis Tower... Don't tell me you went to see Azel!?」

name: Pasta
message: 「That guy is a total villain who put Bylous-nyama through hell, nya!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「So I set out on a retaliatory mission to avenge Bylous-nyama's grudge, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「How reckless... Even Bylous isn't a match for him, you know?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even so, I still wanted to land at least one blow on him, nya!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「But the atmosphere was so weird I couldn't even get close, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
So Azel is still stubbornly trying to stick to his convictions.

name: Synn
message: 「So. What about Bylous...?」

name: Pasta
message: 「He got blown all the way back to the Demon World and can't move a muscle, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... Well, that's a relief」

name: Pasta
message: 「It's not a relief at all, nya!! We were supposed to spend a lovey-dovey Christmas together with Pasta...」

name: Pasta
message: 「Besides, what a horrible thing to say, nya!! Rejoicing in someone else's misfortune--the Demon Lord really is a villain, nya!!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not what I meant! I just meant I'm glad he's alive」

name: Pasta
message: 「With his wish unfulfilled, Bylous-nyama has become an empty shell--he might as well be dead, nya...」

name: Synn
message: 「Someone as strong as him wouldn't get depressed over something like that」

name: Pasta
message: 「You think so, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「I think you, who loves Bylous, would understand that far, far better than I would」

name: Pasta
message: 「You guys... are going to fight that Azel too, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「It might just come to that, yeah」

name: Pasta
message: 「Then I'll help you out, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Pasta
message: 「I won't be satisfied until I get at least one payback hit on that woman Azel, nya!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ha... haha...」
Vengeful Pasta has joined the party!!

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I wonder if I should just be happy about this」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee... but you get it now, right? What I was talking about」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not like I'm aiming for that, though...\s02」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone is drawn to your character, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone is lending me their strength. That makes me really happy.」

name: Synn
message: 「But with everyone's help, what is it that I want to do?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's surely the answer to the conviction you hold, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「My conviction...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Remember. What you've always wanted to do, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-thanks for the meal~~」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm glad you liked it\s04」
I see. So this is what a Kujou family dinner is like.
If you thoroughly cover this many dishes, no wonder you grow breasts that big.
It'd be nice if this made me grow taller too, so Ria-senpai would always be looking up at me.

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, uh, n-nothing!」

name: Ria
message: 「Suspicious. Where were you looking, I wonder?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-that's...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ufufu\s04」
Ria-senpai presses her soft body close and whispers into my ear.

name: Ria
message: 「You were looking... somewhere naughty, weren't you...?」

name: Ria
message: 「I can see right through everything you're thinking, Synn」
Gah... how does she always take control of the conversation so easily.

name: Synn
message: 「Teasing me like that...」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though it's because you're always tempting me, Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「M-My fault!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not just going to let you tease me forever. E-Even I...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Right there!! Get 'em!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-What are you talking about」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's an RPG. It's on auto-battle, so they won't listen to a word I say」
A chaotic game living up to its title where you have no choice but to multiply your money at the casino, huh. If it's that developer, I'd also recommend Touhou Ken●roku.

name: Ria
message: 「S-Sorry. I-If I stay out too late, Mother will get mad at me, so...\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're right. Then, I'll walk you home」

name: Paqy
message: 「Have a nice tri~~p」
Grr~~, damn it.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn... your hands are really big, aren't they」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, what's this all of a sudden」
Grabbing my hand with both of hers, she runs her fingers over it as if checking something.
Ria-senpai really does have a girl's hands, too. They're a whole size smaller than mine and cute.

name: Synn
message: 「S-So what if they are\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「It just really hits home that you're a guy after all. Deeply」

name: Synn
message: 「You're teasing me again like that, aren't you」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm no~~t. Even though I'm complimenting you~~」

name: Ria
message: 「It's because you sulk like that that makes me want to tease you」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see--」

name: Ria
message: 「You gotta act like a real man. For starters, try calling me just 'Ria'」

name: Ria
message: 「Go on, let's hear it--」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh... R-Ria-san」

name: Ria
message: 「That completely defeats the purpose!」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh... Ri...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's actually kind of embarrassing...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm way more embarrassed than you are!」

name: Ria
message: 「While we're at it, why don't we ban polite speech too?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Anything but that... After all this time, there's no way I can just talk casually to Ria-senp-- I mean, Ria, sir!」
And why did I suddenly sound like a jock?

name: Ria
message: 「It is embarrassing. Though, maybe it makes me a little happy too」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is that...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Because it feels like Synn-kun is taking the lead」

name: Synn
message: 「So I really never take the lead normally, huh...\s06」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, of course! I'm the big sister here, after all. Hmph!」
Hrmph... Still, someday even I'll--!

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, let's go!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-See you tomorrow」

name: Ria
message: 「See ya. Get home safe now~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Goodnight, Ria-senpai」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Goodnight... Ria」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪ Goodnight\s04」
No good, I really can't get used to it.
Both now and in the past, to me, she's Ria-senpai.
Still, I'm her boyfriend now, so...
I-I'll try my best starting tomorrow!
Haaah... Ria-senpai's hand was so soft and warm...
Even being apart for just a moment like this feels lonely.
I miss Ria-senpai's soft palm. If only I could keep holding it forever.
Yet even more than her hand, I--
Uwaah, no, no!
How low can I get...

name: Synn
message: 「Daaah. Daaah.」
I stomp my feet on the spot, reprimanding my own heart.

name: Synn
message: 「Uwah, that's bright.」
A light is flickering in one specific spot.
It's coming from Ria-senpai's house.
Ria-senpai is waving her hand from the balcony.
Even though she doesn't know if I'm still here, she went out of her way to...
Overjoyed, I swung my arms around using my whole body.
Seeing that, Ria-senpai laughed so hard.
I really am just a kid, aren't I...
Still, Ria-senpai's smile was the absolute best.
